"""Frozen text-only context predictor, two heldout tests and strict controls."""
import sys,json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import solve
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).parent))
import native_mlp_long_materials as P
from native_mlp_long_features import categories,prefix_features,FEATURES,mcnemar
from shared.dist_protocol.mechanism_trace import unbits,file_sha,digest
def fits(y,ids,pos,x,gram,perm):
    counts=np.bincount(ids,minlength=151936);mu=y.mean(0);means=np.zeros((151936,y.shape[1]),np.float32)
    np.add.at(means,ids,y);means/=np.maximum(1,counts)[:,None];means[counts==0]=mu
    r=y-means[ids];pm=np.stack([r[pos//64==b].mean(0) for b in range(16)])
    r-=pm[pos//64]
    coef=solve(gram,x.T@r,assume_a='pos');null=solve(gram,x.T@r[perm],assume_a='pos')
    return means,pm,coef,null
def main():
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
    data=P.read(P.OUT/'documents.json');collection=P.read(P.OUT/'collection.json');pr=P.read(P.PUBLIC/'prereg.research.json');docs=data['docs'];units=data['units']
    freeze=P.read(P.OUT/'execution-freeze.json');assert all(file_sha(P.ROOT/n)==h for n,h in freeze['dependencies'].items())
    raw=np.load(P.OUT/'input-tokens.npy',mmap_mode='r');tok=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(P.MODEL,local_files_only=True);cat=categories(tok)
    train=[r['doc_index'] for r in docs if r['split']=='discovery'];positions=np.arange(32,1024,8)
    x0=np.concatenate([prefix_features(raw[i,:1024],cat)[positions] for i in train]);mean=x0.mean(0);scale=np.maximum(x0.std(0),.01);x=(x0-mean)/scale
    ids=np.concatenate([raw[i,positions] for i in train]);pos=np.tile(positions,len(train));gram=x.T@x+100*np.eye(x.shape[1]);rng=np.random.default_rng(P.SEED)
    perm=np.arange(len(ids))
    for token in np.unique(ids):
        ix=np.flatnonzero(ids==token);perm[ix]=rng.permutation(ix)
    pair_x={};coins={}
    for split in ['confirm','lockbox']:
        pp=data['pairs'][split];pair_x[split]=[]
        for which in ['a','b']:
            pair_x[split].append(np.stack([prefix_features(raw[p[which],:1024],cat)[p['position']] for p in pp]))
        coins[split]={k:rng.integers(0,2,(len(pp),len(units))).astype(bool) for k in ['base','prediction_tie','truth_tie','null_tie']}
    rows=[];predictions={s:np.zeros((256,2,len(units)),np.float32) for s in pair_x};truths={s:np.zeros((256,2,len(units)),np.float32) for s in pair_x};nulls={s:np.zeros((256,2,len(units)),np.float32) for s in pair_x}
    # Fit discovery, evaluate confirm only; lockbox values are not accessed yet.
    for l in range(36):
        indexes=[i for i,r in enumerate(units) if r['layer']==l];layer_units=[units[i]['unit'] for i in indexes]
        a=np.load(P.OUT/f'L{l:02d}-A.npy',mmap_mode='r');y=unbits(np.asarray(a[train][:,positions])).reshape(-1,len(indexes))
        means,pm,coef,null=fits(y,ids,pos,x,gram,perm)
        np.savez(P.OUT/f'predictor-L{l:02d}.npz',means=means,position_mean=pm,coef=coef,null_coef=null,feature_mean=mean,feature_scale=scale)
        for split in ['confirm']:
            pp=data['pairs'][split]
            for side,key in enumerate(['a','b']):
                px=(pair_x[split][side]-mean)/scale;baseline=np.stack([means[p['token_id']]+pm[p['position']//64] for p in pp])
                predictions[split][:,side,indexes]=baseline+px@coef;nulls[split][:,side,indexes]=baseline+px@null
                truths[split][:,side,indexes]=np.stack([unbits(a[p[key],p['position']]) for p in pp])
        del a,y
    def metrics(split):
        pp=data['pairs'][split];v=truths[split];pred=predictions[split];null=nulls[split];result=[]
        for j,u in enumerate(units):
            truth=np.where(v[:,0,j]!=v[:,1,j],v[:,0,j]>v[:,1,j],coins[split]['truth_tie'][:,j]);base=coins[split]['base'][:,j]
            pick=np.where(pred[:,0,j]!=pred[:,1,j],pred[:,0,j]>pred[:,1,j],coins[split]['prediction_tie'][:,j])
            npick=np.where(null[:,0,j]!=null[:,1,j],null[:,0,j]>null[:,1,j],coins[split]['null_tie'][:,j])
            m=mcnemar(base==truth,pick==truth);neg=mcnemar(base==truth,npick==truth)
            m['nonzero_pair_fraction']=float(np.mean(v[:,0,j]!=v[:,1,j]));m['passed']=bool(m['delta']>=.15 and m['p']<.05/432 and m['nonzero_pair_fraction']>=.8)
            neg['passed']=bool(neg['delta']>=.15 and neg['p']<.05/432)
            result.append({**u,'metrics':m,'shuffle_control':neg})
        return result
    confirm=metrics('confirm');stats=np.load(P.OUT/'population-statistics.npz');write=np.load(P.OUT/'write-norm.npy');group=[];random=[];selected_layers=set();skipped=[]
    for row in sorted([r for r in confirm if r['selection']=='stratified_random'],key=lambda r:-r['metrics']['delta']):
        l,u=row['layer'],row['unit']
        if l in selected_layers:continue
        rms=np.sqrt(stats['squares'][0,l,2]/stats['count'][0]);den=max(rms[u],1e-9);wn=write[l];energy=rms*wn
        candidates=[v for v in range(9728) if v!=u and .8<=rms[v]/den<=1.25 and .8<=wn[v]/max(wn[u],1e-9)<=1.25 and .8<=energy[v]/max(energy[u],1e-9)<=1.25]
        if not candidates:skipped.append([l,u]);continue
        ru=int(rng.choice(candidates));group.append([l,u]);random.append([l,ru]);selected_layers.add(l)
        if len(group)==16:break
    assert len(group)==16
    selection={'kind':'real','run_id':P.RUN,'units':group,'random_units':random,'selected_only':'confirm ranking gains; oneunit per distinctlayer; lockbox tensors not read before this file frozen',
        'matching':'A_RMS,down_column_norm andtheirproduct ratios each in[.8,1.25],same layer','skipped_no_strict_match':skipped,'provenance':collection['provenance']}
    P.save(P.OUT/'selection.json',selection)
    for l in range(36):
        indexes=[i for i,r in enumerate(units) if r['layer']==l];a=np.load(P.OUT/f'L{l:02d}-A.npy',mmap_mode='r');p=np.load(P.OUT/f'predictor-L{l:02d}.npz');pp=data['pairs']['lockbox']
        for side,key in enumerate(['a','b']):
            px=(pair_x['lockbox'][side]-mean)/scale;baseline=np.stack([p['means'][p0['token_id']]+p['position_mean'][p0['position']//64] for p0 in pp])
            predictions['lockbox'][:,side,indexes]=baseline+px@p['coef'];nulls['lockbox'][:,side,indexes]=baseline+px@p['null_coef'];truths['lockbox'][:,side,indexes]=np.stack([unbits(a[p0[key],p0['position']]) for p0 in pp])
    lock=metrics('lockbox');cards=[]
    for j,(c,k) in enumerate(zip(confirm,lock)):
        l,u=c['layer'],c['unit'];pp=np.load(P.OUT/f'predictor-L{l:02d}.npz');sub=[r['unit'] for r in units if r['layer']==l].index(u);coef=pp['coef'][:,sub]
        top=np.argsort(-np.abs(coef))[:5];pole={}
        for fold in [0,1,2]:
            for key in ['Gpos','Gneg','Apos','Aneg']:
                z=np.load(P.OUT/f'pool-{fold}-L{l:02d}-{key}.npz');values=z['value'][:,sub];order=np.argsort(values if key.endswith('neg') else -values)
                h=unbits(z['h'][order[:32],sub]);mu=stats['hsum'][fold,l]/stats['count'][fold];center=h-mu
                norm=np.linalg.norm(center,axis=1);direction=(center/np.maximum(norm[:,None],1e-9)).mean(0)
                pole[f'{fold}:{key}']={'coherence':float(np.linalg.norm(direction)),'examples':[{'doc_index':int(z['doc'][t,sub]),'position':int(z['position'][t,sub]),'value':float(values[t])} for t in order[:8]]}
        params=np.load(P.OUT/f'parameters-L{l:02d}.npz');gp=np.load(P.OUT/f'pool-0-L{l:02d}-Gpos.npz');gn=np.load(P.OUT/f'pool-0-L{l:02d}-Gneg.npz')
        delta=unbits(gp['h'][:,sub]).mean(0)-unbits(gn['h'][:,sub]).mean(0)
        def cosine(x):return float(x@delta/max(np.linalg.norm(x)*np.linalg.norm(delta),1e-12))
        alignment={key:cosine(unbits(params[key][sub])) for key in ['gate','up','down']}
        errors=[]
        split='lockbox';v=truths[split];prv=predictions[split]
        for i,pair in enumerate(data['pairs'][split]):
            if v[i,0,j]!=v[i,1,j] and (prv[i,0,j]>prv[i,1,j])!=(v[i,0,j]>v[i,1,j]):
                errors.append({'pair':pair,'actual':v[i,:,j].tolist(),'prediction':prv[i,:,j].tolist()})
        cards.append({**c,'confirm':c['metrics'],'lockbox':k['metrics'],'replicated':bool(c['metrics']['passed'] and k['metrics']['passed']),
            'shuffle_confirm':c['shuffle_control'],'shuffle_lockbox':k['shuffle_control'],'description_status':'operational prefix-feature predictor; semantic function not independently labelled',
            'prefix_predictor_terms':[{'feature':FEATURES[t],'coefficient':float(coef[t])} for t in top], 'read_write_alignment':alignment,
            'alignment_note':'raw pre-normalization h pole direction, descriptive only; read/write mismatch is not a failed interpretation criterion',
            'poles':pole,'counterexamples':errors[:12],'all_error_count':len(errors)})
    np.savez(P.OUT/'paired-predictions.npz',**{f'{s}_{n}':d[s] for s in ['confirm','lockbox'] for n,d in [('prediction',predictions),('actual',truths),('shuffle',nulls)]})
    result={'kind':'real','run_id':P.RUN,'model_snapshot':collection['model_snapshot'],'cards':cards,'random_units':432,
        'random_replicated':sum(r['replicated'] for r in cards if r['selection']=='stratified_random'),
        'random_shuffle_double_pass':sum(r['shuffle_confirm']['passed'] and r['shuffle_lockbox']['passed'] for r in cards if r['selection']=='stratified_random'),
        'feature_names':FEATURES,'selection':selection,'provenance':collection['provenance']}
    P.save(P.OUT/'analysis.json',result);print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['cards','feature_names','provenance','selection']},ensure_ascii=False))
if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Export real frozen-output diagnostics, never illustrative model results."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).parent))
import native_mlp_long_materials as P
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def main():
    a=P.read(P.OUT/'analysis.json');d=P.read(P.OUT/'dose-result.json');c=P.read(P.OUT/'capability-result.json');z=P.read(P.OUT/'diagnostics.json')
    cards=[r for r in a['cards'] if r['selection']=='stratified_random'];fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(13.5,3.8),layout='constrained')
    axes[0].scatter([100*r['confirm']['delta'] for r in cards],[100*r['lockbox']['delta'] for r in cards],s=10,c='#2979bf',alpha=.5)
    axes[0].axvline(15,color='#dd7843',ls='--');axes[0].axhline(15,color='#dd7843',ls='--');axes[0].set(xlabel='Confirm accuracy gain (pp)',ylabel='Lockbox accuracy gain (pp)',title='0 / 432 pass both preregistered gates')
    axes[0].text(.02,.97,'Matched token + absolute position\nAdditional Bonferroni p and tie gates',va='top',transform=axes[0].transAxes,fontsize=8)
    effects=d['effects'];xs=[0,.5,1];ys=[effects[s]['accuracy'] for s in ['base','target_half','target_full']]
    axes[1].plot(xs,ys,'o-',c='#2979bf',label='Selected16');axes[1].scatter([1],[effects['random_full']['accuracy']],color='#dd7843',marker='x',s=70,label='Matched random16');axes[1].set(ylim=(.38,.48),xlabel='Query-only ablation strength',ylabel='Natural next-token top1 accuracy',title='Joint effect gate not supported');axes[1].legend(fontsize=8)
    lo,hi=np.asarray(c['loss_interval'])*100;loss=c['net_loss']*100;axes[2].errorbar([loss],[0],xerr=[[loss-lo],[hi-loss]],fmt='o',color='#2979bf',capsize=6);axes[2].axvline(2,color='#dd7843',ls='--',label='NI margin: 2 pp');axes[2].set(xlabel='Keyed capability accuracy loss (pp)',yticks=[],xlim=(-.6,2.4),ylim=(-1,1),title='2,200-item repeated-pool NI gate passed');axes[2].legend(fontsize=8)
    fig.suptitle('Qwen3-4B | 2,048 natural documents x 1,024 tokens | finite operational context model',fontsize=11)
    for ax in axes:ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
    fig.savefig(P.OUT/'research-results.png',dpi=200);fig.savefig(P.OUT/'research-results.pdf');plt.close(fig)
if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Document-disjoint long-context native-neuron audit; no model activations here."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,hashlib
import numpy as np
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from shared.dist_protocol.mechanism_trace import digest,file_sha
from tools.power_analysis import check_phase
OUT=ROOT/'tests/glm5/result/native_mlp_long_v1';PUBLIC=ROOT/'research/native_mlp_long/v1'
RUN='NMLP-LONG-20261104-v1';MODEL=Path('D:/develop/model/Qwen/Qwen3-4B');SEED=28112026
LEGACY=Path('D:/ai2050_native/_census/corpus/2ca5f0a756d36c8a')
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
def save(p,d,immutable=True):
    p=Path(p);p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);b=json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False)
    if immutable and p.exists():
        if p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')!=b:raise ValueError('immutable file differs: '+str(p))
    else:p.write_text(b,encoding='utf-8')
def sha_tokens(t):return hashlib.sha256(np.asarray(t,np.int32).tobytes()).hexdigest()

def fetch():
    import pyarrow.parquet as pq
    from huggingface_hub import HfFileSystem
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
    tok=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL,local_files_only=True);man=read(LEGACY/'manifest.json');fs=HfFileSystem(token=False)
    for s in man['sources']:
        if not s['source'].startswith('wikipedia'):continue
        dest=OUT/(s['source']+'-fresh.json');
        if dest.exists():continue
        fn=s['row_groups'][0]['file'];start=max(x['row_group'] for x in s['row_groups'] if x['file']==fn)+1;docs=[];used=[]
        with fs.open(f'datasets/{s["repo"]}@{s["revision"]}/{fn}','rb',block_size=8*1024**2) as fh:
            pf=pq.ParquetFile(fh)
            for rg in range(start,pf.num_row_groups):
                columns=[n for n in ['id','url','title','text'] if n in pf.schema_arrow.names]
                data=pf.read_row_group(rg,columns=columns).to_pylist();used.append(rg)
                for row,r in enumerate(data):
                    ids=tok.encode(r['text'],add_special_tokens=False)
                    if len(ids)<1025:continue
                    docs.append({'source':s['source'],'repo':s['repo'],'revision':s['revision'],'license':s['license'],'file':fn,
                        'row_group':rg,'row':row,'id':str(r.get('id','')),'url':r.get('url',''),'title':r.get('title',''),
                        'tokens':ids[:2048],'original_token_length':len(ids)})
                print(json.dumps({'source':s['source'],'row_group':rg,'long_docs':len(docs)}),flush=True)
                if len(docs)>=800:break
        assert len(docs)>=512
        save(dest,{'source':s,'unused_row_groups':used,'docs':docs,'note':'row groups beyond prior20M census; not guaranteed unseen in model pretraining'})

def build():
    man=read(LEGACY/'manifest.json');legacy_hashes=set();training=[]
    assert file_sha(ROOT/'models/hf/qwen3-4b/tokenizer.json')==file_sha(MODEL/'tokenizer.json')
    for s in man['sources']:
        path=LEGACY/s['file'];assert file_sha(path)==s['file_sha256']
        z=np.load(path);tokens=z['tokens'];starts=z['doc_starts'];ends=np.r_[starts[1:]-1,len(tokens)-1]
        candidates=[]
        for index,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(starts,ends)):
            if b-a<1025:continue
            ids=tokens[a:min(b,a+2048)];h=sha_tokens(ids[:1024]);legacy_hashes.add(h)
            if s['source'].startswith('fineweb'):
                candidates.append({'source':s['source'],'repo':s['repo'],'revision':s['revision'],'license':s['license'],
                    'legacy_stream_offset':int(a),'id':f'{s["source"]}:{index}','tokens':ids.tolist(),'prefix_sha256':h,'split':'discovery'})
        if candidates:
            unique={r['prefix_sha256']:r for r in candidates};ordered=sorted(unique.values(),key=lambda r:digest({'seed':SEED,'id':r['id']}))
            assert len(ordered)>=512;training.extend(ordered[:512])
    held=[];newhash=set();excluded=0
    for source in ['wikipedia-en','wikipedia-zh']:
        docs=read(OUT/(source+'-fresh.json'))['docs'];chosen=[]
        for r in sorted(docs,key=lambda r:digest({'seed':SEED,'id':r['id'],'source':source})):
            h=sha_tokens(r['tokens'][:1024])
            if h in legacy_hashes or h in newhash:excluded+=1;continue
            newhash.add(h);chosen.append({**r,'prefix_sha256':h})
            if len(chosen)==512:break
        assert len(chosen)==512
        for i,r in enumerate(chosen):r['split']='confirm' if i<256 else 'lockbox'
        held.extend(chosen)
    docs=training+held;assert len(docs)==2048
    # Conservative near-duplicate check: 5-token shingle overlap, candidates from
    # 16 MinHashes/4 bands. Fail instead of silently mixing near-duplicate splits.
    rng=np.random.default_rng(SEED);aa=rng.integers(1,2**63,16,dtype=np.uint64)|np.uint64(1);bb=rng.integers(0,2**63,16,dtype=np.uint64)
    bands={};shingles=[];near=[]
    for i,r in enumerate(docs):
        t=np.asarray(r['tokens'][:1024],np.uint64);h=np.zeros(1020,np.uint64)
        with np.errstate(over='ignore'):
            for k in range(5):h=h*np.uint64(1000003)+t[k:k+1020]
            h=np.unique(h);sig=(h[None,:]*aa[:,None]+bb[:,None]).min(1)
        candidates=set()
        for k in range(4):candidates.update(bands.get((k,tuple(sig[k*4:k*4+4])),[]))
        for j in candidates:
            overlap=len(np.intersect1d(h,shingles[j],assume_unique=True));sim=overlap/(len(h)+len(shingles[j])-overlap)
            if sim>=.85 and docs[j]['split']!=r['split']:near.append({'a':j,'b':i,'jaccard':sim})
        for k in range(4):bands.setdefault((k,tuple(sig[k*4:k*4+4])),[]).append(i)
        shingles.append(h)
    assert not near,near[:3]
    raw=np.full((2048,2048),151643,np.int32)
    for i,r in enumerate(docs):raw[i,:len(r['tokens'])]=r['tokens'];r['doc_index']=i;r['doc_id']=r['source']+':'+str(r['id'])
    np.save(OUT/'input-tokens.npy',raw)
    pairs={}
    seen=np.bincount(raw[:1024,:1024].ravel(),minlength=151936)
    for split in ['confirm','lockbox']:
        pp=[]
        for source in ['wikipedia-en','wikipedia-zh']:
            ix=[r['doc_index'] for r in docs if r['split']==split and r['source']==source]
            from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
            left,right=ix[:128],ix[128:];matches=((raw[left,None,512:1024]==raw[None,right,512:1024])&(seen[raw[left,None,512:1024]]>=20)).sum(-1)
            rr,cc=linear_sum_assignment(np.where(matches>0,0.,1e6)+rng.random(matches.shape))
            assert np.all(matches[rr,cc]>0),'no complete text-only matched pairing'
            for a,b in [(left[i],right[j]) for i,j in zip(rr,cc)]:
                positions=np.flatnonzero((raw[a,512:1024]==raw[b,512:1024])&(seen[raw[a,512:1024]]>=20))+512
                assert len(positions)>0,(a,b)
                pos=int(positions[int(digest({'seed':SEED,'a':a,'b':b})[:8],16)%len(positions)])
                pp.append({'a':a,'b':b,'position':pos,'token_id':int(raw[a,pos]),'pair_id':split+f':{a}:{b}'})
        assert len(pp)==256;pairs[split]=pp
    units=[]
    for l in range(36):
        units.extend({'layer':l,'unit':int(u),'selection':'stratified_random'} for u in rng.choice(9728,12,replace=False))
    prior=read(ROOT/'tests/glm5/result/phase2794_arbitration_v4/selection.json')['units']+[[30,9517],[30,80]]
    for l,u in prior:
        if not any(r['layer']==l and r['unit']==u for r in units):units.append({'layer':l,'unit':u,'selection':'prior_purposive'})
    save(OUT/'documents.json',{'docs':[{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='tokens'} for r in docs],'pairs':pairs,'units':units,
        'legacy_exact_prefix_exclusions':excluded,'cross_split_near_duplicates':near,'near_duplicate_check':'16 MinHash/4bands candidates, exact5-token Jaccard>=.85; not exhaustive all-pair similarity',
        'input_tokens_sha256':file_sha(OUT/'input-tokens.npy')})
    power=check_phase(.25,256,p_d=.5,alpha=.05/432);assert power['pass']
    prereg={'schema':'native_mlp_long_prereg.v1','kind':'real','run_id':RUN,'seed':SEED,'model_snapshot':read(ROOT/'research/phase2794/report.research.json')['model_snapshot'],
        'documents_sha256':file_sha(OUT/'documents.json'),'input_tokens_sha256':file_sha(OUT/'input-tokens.npy'),'natural_docs':2048,'input_tokens':2097152,
        'splits':'1024 discovery fineweb en/zh,512 confirm and512lockbox fresh wikipedia en/zh rowgroups not used by priorcensus; exactprefix overlap with old corpus excluded; model pretraining exposure unknown',
        'sampling':'432 random native units,12/layer; earlier32+2 purposed units separate; not the whole population explained',
        'collection':'1024-token plain documents, no chat template; first32 positions excluded from statistics; all350208 native G/V/A moments, regimes andextrema; complete selected G/V/A at all input positions andall37 hidden states at final position retained',
        'primary':'for432 random units, predict A ordering of same-token, same-absolute-position paired fresh documents atposition>=512; pairs frozen fromtext before activations, independent doc pairs',
        'predictor':'discovery token means + position-bin residual + Ridge lambda100 onprefix token-category counts at16/64/256/512 andpreceding4 categories; training samplesevery8positions after32. No hidden state/future token/sourceID input.',
        'criteria':{'expected_delta':.25,'power':power,'minimum_delta_vs_random_tie_baseline':.15,'alpha_per_unit':.05/432,'confirm_and_lockbox_both_required':True,'min_nonzero_pair_fraction':.8},
        'negative_control':'same-token shuffle of discovery residuals before fitting context; samefrozen controls andp-value thresholds; original-token baseline is tied byconstruction',

"""Post-hoc numerical sham audit, separate from frozen research verdicts."""
import sys,json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).parent))
import native_mlp_long_materials as P
from native_mlp_long_validate import install
from shared.dist_protocol.mechanism_trace import GpuLease,file_sha
from shared.dist_protocol.natural_register_runner import snapshot
def main():
    import torch
    from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM
    s=P.read(P.OUT/'selection.json');d=P.read(P.OUT/'documents.json');prov=s['provenance'];raw=np.load(P.OUT/'input-tokens.npy',mmap_mode='r')
    P.save(P.OUT/'numeric-contract.json',{'kind':'real','run_id':P.RUN,'script_sha256':file_sha(__file__),'n':32,'selection':'first32 frozen lockbox A-documents, not chosen by effect',
        'scope':'post-hoc exact-copy alpha0 numerical sham; no new mechanism claim','provenance':prov})
    rows=[]
    with GpuLease():
        assert snapshot(P.MODEL)==prov['model_revision'];torch.set_num_threads(4)
        m=AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(P.MODEL,local_files_only=True,dtype=torch.bfloat16,device_map='cuda',attn_implementation='sdpa').eval().requires_grad_(False)
        for pair in d['pairs']['lockbox'][:32]:
            ids=torch.tensor(np.asarray(raw[pair['a'],:1024])[None],device='cuda');q=pair['position']
            with torch.inference_mode():base=m(input_ids=ids,use_cache=False,logits_to_keep=torch.tensor([q],device='cuda')).logits[0,-1].clone()
            hs=install(m,s['units'],0,q)
            try:
                with torch.inference_mode():sham=m(input_ids=ids,use_cache=False,logits_to_keep=torch.tensor([q],device='cuda')).logits[0,-1]
            finally:
                for h in hs:h.remove()
            rows.append({'doc_index':pair['a'],'position':q,'bitwise_equal':bool(torch.equal(base,sham)),'max_abs_error':float((base.float()-sham.float()).abs().max())})
        assert snapshot(P.MODEL)==prov['model_revision']
    P.save(P.OUT/'numeric-result.json',{'kind':'real','run_id':P.RUN,'rows':rows,'all_equal':all(r['bitwise_equal'] for r in rows),'provenance':prov});print(json.dumps({'all_equal':all(r['bitwise_equal'] for r in rows)}))
if __name__=='__main__':main()
